messages:
Priya: Hey team — FinCo wants a concise POC playbook for migrating ~120k users from Okta into our tenant. Their checklist: SCIM bulk import + ongoing delta sync, SAML as primary SSO with a hosted fallback, per-tenant domain ownership controls, delegated admin roles, and RBAC mapping to their group model. Any hard blockers or major caveats? @Jordan can you sketch constraints and a 2-week POC plan?

Jordan: Quick high-level: we can cover all of that but there are operational limits to call out. Short bullets first, then a recommended flow.

Jordan: Bullets — SCIM: we support BULK (staged CSV -> SCIM import) and incremental PATCH delta sync. Hosted rate-limit is ~50 req/s, Dedicated reserved pools can do ~200 req/s depending on commit. Bulk imports should be staged (10–20k users per batch) to avoid timeouts and long-lived transactions.

Jordan: Role/group mapping — we map SCIM groups -> Redwood roles. We do not support nested group inheritance in the POC mapping (flat groups only). Please confirm which Okta group -> Redwood role mappings they need. Max 1000 members per group PATCH.

Jordan: SAML — we require signed assertions. NameID=email (recommended). Map attributes: email -> user.email, givenName/lastName -> metadata, groups -> roles. SAML cert rotation: upload new cert and enable overlap window (we recommend 7 days). Metadata URL is supported.

Jordan: Domain ownership — verification via DNS TXT record per domain. We can attach multiple domains to a tenant but automated provisioning of domains at scale requires a programmatic DNS step on their side. If they need delegated domain control (let them manage DNS verification themselves) we can record the verification and enforce tenant lock.

Jordan: Session/affinity notes — SAML session length is configurable per-tenant; if they rely on long sessions we should exercise prefix caching to avoid regen overhead. Fallbacks: if SAML IdP is unreachable we can fall back to hosted OAuth tokens for service accounts.

Jordan: Example SCIM PATCH (delta):
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users/<id> \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" \\n  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"active","value":true}]}'
```

Jordan: For bulk onboarding we usually: 1) provision service-account + SCIM token, 2) run a dry-run on a 1000-user slice, 3) validate role mapping + sign-in flows, 4) ramp batches, 5) cutover and monitor.

Nora: Security checklist items from our side: we can share SOC2 Type II, pen test summary, encryption at-rest (AES-256) + in-transit (TLS1.2+), and our standard incident response playbook. For Dedicated/Private we support KMS/HSM integration and customer-managed keys.

Nora: SCIM security specifics — SCIM endpoints are TLS-only. For Private deployments we can enable mTLS. We do not store Okta credentials, only the SCIM tokens needed for provisioning. Audit logs: every SCIM change is logged and available in Console (admin->audit) for 90 days (longer retention is an add-on).

Nora: SAML requirements — assertions must be signed. We accept SHA-256 signatures / digests. Recommend we request their SSO security contact to complete our short questionnaire. Send the formal security pack to security@redwood.com. :mailbox_with_mail:

Alex: Pricing / POC ops — Hosted is easiest for a quick POC and we can provide credits to cover delta traffic for 2 weeks. However, with 120k users and aggressive ramping they may hit hosted rate limits; Dedicated is recommended if they need predictable throughput and faster bulk imports. I'll produce a Dedicated sizing quote with two commit options: baseline (1x pool) and peak (burst capacity).

Alex: Suggested 2-week POC timeline:
- Day 0–2: contract + security NDA + domain proofing (DNS TXT)
- Day 3–7: provision SCIM service account, do 1k dry-run, map roles, smoke SAML login
- Day 8–12: staged bulk import (10–20k batches), reconcile, fix mapping edge cases
- Day 13–14: finalize cutover, verify audit logs, run failover test

Alex: POC acceptance criteria: 1) 10k users imported with correct role mapping, 2) SAML login success rate >= 99% for test cohort, 3) SCIM delta sync latency < 30s on Dedicated (or < 90s on Hosted during POC).

Priya: Great — Jordan can you drop the exact hosted vs dedicated SCIM rate numbers + a short ops playbook I can forward? Alex pls prepare a quick Dedicated sizing estimate and call out any minimum commitment assumptions. Nora pls send the security pack and a pointer to the questionnaire. I’ll book a call with FinCo for Wed 10am PT.

Jordan: Will do. I'll attach a plain-text ops checklist and a one-pager on role mapping after this thread. :thumbsup:

Alex: I'll have a draft quote by EOD and note the commitment options.

Nora: Sending security package to Priya now, copied security@redwood.com.

DeployBot: scheduled deploy to staging at 3300001300 by @Jordan — SCIM import helper (no user-impact)

Priya: Thanks all — I'll confirm meeting invite and include FinCo SSO contact.
